note: R2 logprob fallback (C4), design side only, 267 runs, 22 R2 runs. Feature: min over answer fields of mean_logprob of the reasoning step. Threshold maximises F1 of 'is R2'.
finding: R2 runs are not less confident at the sampled tokens than other runs (median -0.035 vs -0.089), so C4 carries almost no R2 signal; temperature > 0 is only visible in C3.
